input.command: cd D:\pal; echo "== raw companies body (first 120 chars) x3 =="; 1..3 | ForEach-Object { $w = Invoke-WebRequest 'http://127.0.0.1:8082/api/v1/companies' -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 15; "  $_ => len=$($w.Content.Length) startsWith=$($w.Content.Substring(0,1)) rows=$(($w.Content | ConvertFrom-Json).Count)" }; echo "== tally status x3 =="; 1..3 | ForEach-Object { try { "  $_ => $((Invoke-RestMethod 'http://127.0.0.1:8082/api/v1/tally/status' -TimeoutSec 12) | ConvertTo-Json -Compress)" } catch { "  $_ => ERR" } }
